title: Docker Logging Routes & Production Reliability
description: Resolved route exclusion issues for system logs in containerized Docker production builds.
message: v0.2.8 addresses a critical packaging issue where system logs routes were inadvertently excluded during Docker container builds.
With this fix, operators can reliably access audit and workflow execution logs directly within standard Docker deployments.

title: Production Logs Routing & Auth Layout Refinement
description: Improved Docker production logging pipelines and refined platform authentication layout.
message: v0.2.7 enhances containerized runtime reliability by correcting production logs routing paths.
It also refines the responsive authentication split layout across desktop and mobile screens.

title: Changelog & Documentation Alignment
description: Updated product changelog and synchronized documentation for core deployment features.
message: v0.2.6 synchronizes release notes and developer guides with recent runtime improvements.
Clearer deployment documentation helps teams bring Clouisle up quickly in private cloud environments.

title: Bytecode Container Packaging & Workflow Logs
description: Packaged backend application as bytecode in Docker images and fixed frontend API routing for workflow logs.
message: v0.2.5 packages backend services into optimized Python bytecode within Docker images for faster startup and enhanced code protection.
It also resolves frontend API routing edge cases, restoring reliable realtime workflow execution logs.

title: Release Guardrails, Skill Git Support & Unified UI
description: Release tags strictly enforced to main, pre-installed git for skill imports, unified delete UI, and streaming exception protection.
message: v0.2.4 tightens release governance by enforcing release tags directly against main.
Git is now pre-installed in container runtime to streamline third-party skill imports. We also unified delete modal styles and eliminated stack trace leaks in chat streaming.

title: Split Auth Layout & Automated Issue Assignment
description: Added modern split authentication screen layout and automated GitHub project issue assignment.
message: v0.2.3 introduces a brand-new split auth layout with customizable branding artwork on desktop screens.
On the project governance side, automated issue assignment keeps maintainer feedback loops fast.

title: DeepSeek Workflow Engine & Documentation Sync
description: Full DeepSeek model provider support for Agentic Workflows and automated documentation consistency checks.
message: v0.2.2 unlocks DeepSeek model support across Agentic Workflows, giving users high-efficiency reasoning with flexible configurations.
We also established automated CI workflows to verify that deployment and environment variables remain synchronized across documentation and code.

title: User Memory System & Interactive Agent Requests
description: Persistent user memory architecture, human-in-the-loop agent input requests, and multi-architecture Docker pipeline.
message: v0.2.1 delivers the User Memory System, enabling agents to remember user preferences, context, and project conventions across conversations.
Agents can now also pause during complex runs to request structured input from the user before proceeding, establishing genuine human-agent partnership.

title: Enterprise Agent Platform & Multi-Model Engine
description: Multi-tenant workspaces, hybrid RAG knowledge bases, MCP tool ecosystem, and SSO security controls.
message: v0.2.0 establishes the foundation of Clouisle: a next-generation multi-agent collaboration platform.
Featuring enterprise RBAC, private deployment guardrails, hybrid vector search, unified LLM management, and extensible Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
